upstream.v24_3_18_code: group_manager::delete_offsets: auto it = _groups.find(group->id()); co_await it->second->shutdown(); _groups.erase(it); the iterator is not re-validated after the suspension. handle_offset_expiration runs delete_expired_offsets over a snapshot with ss::max_concurrent_for_each, max_concurrent_expirations = 10. delete_groups erases by key and calls _groups.rehash(0).
upstream.fix: redpanda-data/redpanda#31221 [CORE-16883] kafka: erase group before awaiting shutdown(), merged 2026-07-22; upstream symptom: assert seastar::gate::close() cannot be called more than once
upstream.released_tags: Docker Hub: v25.3.16 2026-08-13 (first fixed), v25.3.17 2026-08-20, v25.3.18 2026-10-23; newest v25.2.x is v25.2.14 2026-01-22, before the backport merged; newest v25.1.x is v25.1.12
upstream.upgrade_constraint: v25.3.x feature_table.cc: earliest_version = to_cluster_version(release_version::v25_2_1), commented 'The earliest version we can upgrade from'
upstream.link_to_these_crashes: inferred, unverified: the fixed race erases a stale _groups iterator after a suspension; list_groups then walks _groups and reads a null or freed group (si_addr 0x40) or a garbage state (uncaught exception in group_state_to_kafka_name). Not reproduced; no debug symbols.

group_census.note: Per-call uniquely named groups go Empty, then dead under group_offset_retention, which is the expiry path that runs the racing erase.

request_census.source: vectorized_kafka_handler_requests_completed_total on the dev broker admin API
request_census.note: The dev healthcheck onex-broker-readiness-probe runs rpk group describe -r '.*' about every 33 s (ListGroups, then DescribeGroups and one OffsetFetch per group), so it walks the whole group map; the race itself is on the group expiry side. offset_delete is 0, so the racing erase is reached through expiry, not the OffsetDelete API.

arena_exhaustion_since_cap.reading: The 3G arena is below what this volume's 4605 topics and the 8100 client connections need: the broker aborts on allocation failure at the cap, in fetch handling and in start-up recovery, where it did not at 12G. The cap replaced a crash about every 3.4 h (5 in 17 h, three of them with ListGroups frames) with an allocation-failure abort about every 14 min (12 in 170 min). The ListGroups fix path in fix_path is unchanged and still pending. Not measured: the smallest arena this volume survives (no copy of the 51 GB volume was started on the loaded h201: load average 57, swap in use), and which client calls drive the metadata volume.
arena_exhaustion_since_cap.decision_needed: OPERATOR-CONSENT 2026-10-25T17:53:44Z approved a 2-4 GB cap and scripts/preflight_required_compose_env.py refuses anything outside 2-4 GiB, so this lane did not move the arena. Options for the operator: restore the 12G arena (the floor docker-compose.dev-bus-ha.yml records), set an arena between 4 GiB and 12G with a matching container limit, or cut the topic and connection count first (deleting topics is destructive and needs a named list).
